integrity: Analytical argument with an independently implemented finite exact-arithmetic checker; same-model review only, no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Results rely on the ambient induced Euclidean metric and do not apply to weighted books or arbitrary affine lattice realizations; the first two-page instance overlaps a known fan graph. Literature priority is provisional, and finite computations are not infinite proofs.
scientific_scope: Canonical unweighted Euclidean symmetric edge polytopes of triangular-book graphs with at least two pages; exact support-plane spectra, inball-center dimensions, and second shell.
title: Exact facet shells and a parity jump in the optimal incenter locus of triangular-book symmetric edge polytopes
